checks.name: Natural notes alternate exact staff lines and spaces
Sharps share the natural note position and use sharp spelling
Octaves preserve seven diatonic steps and 28 points
E2 and C7 fit the fixed 160-point canvas
Ledger lines include all lines between the staff and the head
Absent, invalid, low confidence and out-of-range pitches are rejected
Hysteresis prevents semitone boundary chatter
First missing melody waits faintly on B4
Fresh targets preserve position and movement starts on the next refresh
Accepted targets and repeated notes settle within 150ms
High-confidence isolated notes and two-frame octave intrusions leave no spikes
Semitone and whole-tone vocal motion changes the target on its first frame
Sustained thirds, fifths and octaves confirm within 30, 50 and 75ms at 48kHz
Confirmed jumps keep their full staff distance and the trail reaches the true note
A quick melodic phrase with thirds and fourths keeps every sustained note
Unrelated high and low candidates cannot accumulate into a confirmed jump
A sustained new register can confirm despite nearby semitone variation
Repeated snapshots cannot confirm a jump or append trajectory points
Widely spaced observations cannot be treated as continuous confirmation
Unconfirmed candidates do not keep an old reliable pitch alive indefinitely
The first fresh pitch after expiry starts a new segment immediately
Missing melody clears pending confirmation and starts the next trace at its true height
The trail softens its first corner and reaches 95 percent of a small change within 90ms
Volume changes size while leaving true pitch and base motion identical
Dense onsets preserve continuous position and bounded bounce
Trace preserves the accepted note and ignores loudness and decorative bounce
Trace capacity never exceeds 512 samples
History moves left in real time and fades
All history expires after eight seconds, including long scheduling gaps
Unreliable pitch holds the last height and fades the label
Sound without melody holds pitch, stops history and still follows onsets
Silence stops kicks while existing bounce settles smoothly
Snapshot and event duplicates do not replay actions or trajectory
Cached melody expires even when the snapshot remains fresh
Stale audio cannot move the note or start actions
Reconnect isolates old history and accepts the new generation
Audio format changes discard old history and queued kicks
PCM timeline reset does not connect unrelated trajectories
Hidden session stops consuming and clears hidden history
Resume rejects an expired hidden snapshot
Resume starts a fresh trajectory from current reliable input
Disconnected state holds height and lets existing history fade
Missing melody breaks the drawn trajectory between reliable segments
Switch through the real channel consumes current pitch without old bursts
New channel onsets animate immediately while a large pitch jump is pending
A sustained octave is confirmed through the production feature channel
Hidden channel events are skipped and only current pitch starts fresh history
Long render stalls expire old history while retaining the fresh current sample
